text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: mean error on 24 December to 2 January over the mean error on ordinary weekdays at the same half- hours, leads 0.5 to 168 hours, all Primary substations with a fitted model. Line: 95% interval from resampling days. Green: only fits with 180 or more days of training rows. Dashed lines at 1 (same) and 1.3 (the limit). Lower is better.'
